question: Can source-only chart statistics predict a bounded explicit paired-code-domain look operator across a completely held illuminant, rather than selecting a known condition or averaging one global operator?

data.content_control: the same SG and Classic chart patches occur in every exposure and illuminant group
data.outer_split: leave one complete author-declared illuminant out
data.target_use: targets fit development group operators and evaluator Oracle only; source descriptors never contain target values

predictor.alpha_selection: nested leave-one-development-illuminant-out; minimum mean operator-parameter RMSE, then larger alpha
predictor.decode: clip predicted logits to the frozen operator bounds, then analytically decode positive curves and matrix
predictor.negative_control: one deterministic outer-development permutation of fitted operator parameter rows

controls.global: same bounded operator family fit on all outer-development patches
controls.oracle: same bounded operator family fit separately on each held group using its targets; evaluator only
controls.shuffled: same source descriptor and ridge procedure with permuted development operator parameters

branches.pass: retain a source-conditioned bounded explicit-operator research candidate; no validation render opens because the only scene is already consumed
branches.oracle_only: conditional value exists but the source descriptor cannot recover it; close this predictor and retain global fallback
branches.no_oracle: the bounded operator family has insufficient conditional value; close routing and use the global operator
branches.shuffled_or_unstable: treat the apparent gain as nuisance or small-sample instability and close
branches.structural_failure: close without clipping, threshold relaxation or parameter-capacity rescue

claim_ceiling: internal paired code-domain Look Approximation evidence for source-conditioned bounded explicit operators within one author-prepared Sony FX3/Ektachrome E100 capture-and-scan session; no physical exposure or illuminant inference, film mode, calibrated stock response, scanner independence, public asset or product promotion
